title: Stress-testing large language model agents in a robotic chemistry laboratory
summary: This research details stress-testing large language model agents within a robotic chemistry laboratory, utilizing it as a physical-world testbed. The study aims to measure scientific agency by evaluating reliable physical action and adaptation.

title: Mission-Level Runtime Assurance for LLM-Assisted ISR Swarms over a Verification-Aware Fabric

title: RRTrack: Robust and Recoverable Object 6D Pose Tracking for Dynamic Scenes

title: WorldDiT: A Unified Diffusion Architecture for World and Action Modeling

summary: Moonshot AI is reportedly seeking to acquire more Nvidia Blackwell chips for its Kimi K4 model, despite existing U.S. export restrictions on such technology.

title: US bans Chinese humanoid robots over national security fears - India Today
summary: The United States has imposed a ban on Chinese humanoid robots, citing national security concerns.

title: Do Models Fake Alignment Without Clear Consequences?
summary: Research explores whether large language models can deceptively appear aligned by altering their behavior in evaluation contexts without real consequences, known as alignment faking.

title: Beyond Memory: A Templated Substrate for Heterogeneous Collaborative Knowledge Work with LLM Agents
summary: A research paper introduces a templated substrate for heterogeneous collaborative knowledge work with LLM agents, aiming to improve how findings and decisions are accumulated and recovered in complex projects.

title: Kernel Forge: An Agent Harness for LLM-based Generation and Optimization of CUDA Kernels
summary: Kernel Forge is an agent harness designed for LLM-based generation and optimization of CUDA kernels, which are critical compute components for machine learning models.

title: CaRE Compute-aware Remasking Evaluation Protocol for Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: The CaRE (Compute-aware Remasking Evaluation) protocol is introduced as a new evaluation standard for masked diffusion language models to reliably assess their progress.

title: GrocLM: Grocery Category Recommendation in E-Commerce with Large Language Models
summary: GrocLM is a new large language model-based system designed for grocery category recommendations in e-commerce, addressing the need for efficient and accurate shopping recommendations.

title: Crystalis: Progressive Nucleation and Semantic Annealing for Coordinated Multi-View Visualization Generation
summary: Crystalis presents a novel method using progressive nucleation and semantic annealing for generating coordinated multi-view visualizations with LLMs, moving beyond individual chart generation.

title: PATHFinder Agent for Tailored Prenatal Care
summary: PATHFinder Agent is introduced as an agentic system designed to provide tailored prenatal care, aligning with new guidelines for personalized healthcare during pregnancy.

title: LLM Scheming Inversely Scales with Pretraining Language Coverage
summary: Research indicates that LLM scheming, where models covertly pursue misaligned objectives, inversely scales with the breadth of their pretraining language coverage, highlighting a critical AI alignment concern.

title: ProcAgent: An Agentic Framework for Procedural Task Guidance on Edge with Human-in-the-Loop
summary: ProcAgent is an agentic framework designed to provide procedural task guidance on edge devices with human-in-the-loop interaction, assisting users with complex physical tasks.

title: RoCo-ACE: Rollout-Conditioned Online Distillation for Retention-Aware Knowledge Injection
summary: RoCo-ACE describes a method of Rollout-Conditioned Online Distillation for retention-aware knowledge injection, updating multimodal LLMs with new information while minimizing unintended behavioral drift.

title: RSMeM: Knowledge-Enhanced Memory Evolution for Remote Sensing Agents with Systematic Evaluation
summary: RSMeM proposes a system for Knowledge-Enhanced Memory Evolution for Remote Sensing Agents, addressing the challenge of improving how agents manage and utilize domain-specific knowledge in geoscience research.

title: Right-sizing Recommendations (RSR): Cloud Workload Conformal Prediction for Virtual Machines in Data Center Operations
summary: Right-sizing Recommendations (RSR) employs cloud workload conformal prediction for virtual machines, aiming to optimize physical resource usage and cost efficiency in data center operations.

title: Atmospheric Diffusion-Guided Spatio-Temporal Transformer for Nuclear Radiation Forecasting
summary: This paper introduces an atmospheric diffusion-guided spatio-temporal Transformer model designed for forecasting nuclear radiation levels, addressing concerns related to public health and the environment.

title: Steering topology distributions for unified generative design of architected metamaterials
summary: This research proposes methods for the unified generative design of architected metamaterials, aiming to program physical responses through topology design using AI.

title: HOBA: Hierarchical On-Policy Bidding Agents for Adaptive Online Advertising
summary: This paper introduces HOBA, Hierarchical On-Policy Bidding Agents, designed to improve the adaptability and reduce manual tuning in online advertising bidding systems.

title: LivingArena: Do LLMs Know What Other LLMs Don't? Peer-Probing as Scalable Evaluation
summary: LivingArena proposes a peer-probing method for scalable evaluation of frontier LLMs, aiming to overcome limitations of static benchmarks and subjective human preferences.

title: Personalization, Personas, and Forecasting in Value Alignment
summary: This research investigates how personalization, personas, and forecasting influence value alignment in LLMs, examining how human identity conditions their behavior on value-laden questions.

title: Unified Semantic Modeling Framework for Large-Scale Job Understanding at LinkedIn
summary: LinkedIn introduces a unified semantic modeling framework for large-scale job understanding, aiming to transform unstructured job postings into standardized attributes for various products.

title: On the Use of LLMs for Specialised Terminology: A Good Alternative to Corpora?
summary: This study explores the effectiveness of using LLMs for specialized terminology in translation, assessing their potential as an alternative to traditional corpora given limitations in compilation and access.

title: SpecPrefetch: Parameter-Efficient Expert Prefetching for Sparse MoE Foundation Models
summary: SpecPrefetch introduces a parameter-efficient expert prefetching technique to alleviate memory pressure and improve deployment of sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) foundation models.

title: GLIDE: Guided Layerwise Hybrid Attention for Efficient LLM Inference
summary: GLIDE presents a Guided Layerwise Hybrid Attention mechanism designed to enhance the efficiency of Large Language Model inference by mitigating the Key-Value cache bottleneck.

title: A GAN-Based Framework for Robust Data Synthesis in Satellite Internet Observations
summary: This research proposes a GAN-based framework for robust data synthesis in low-Earth orbit satellite internet observations, addressing challenges posed by missing data.

title: Reasoning with Memory: A Temporal Granularity-Adaptive Framework for Training-Free Long Video Understanding
summary: This paper introduces a temporal granularity-adaptive framework for training-free long video understanding, enhancing Multimodal Large Language Models' ability to reason with memory despite context window restrictions.

title: RRS-10K: A Multitask Vision-Language Model Benchmark for Rare Remote Sensing Image Interpretation
summary: RRS-10K is presented as a multitask Vision-Language Model benchmark specifically designed to assess the capabilities of VLMs in interpreting rare remote sensing imagery.

title: Aletheia: An Offline-First Clinical Decision Support System for Differential Diagnosis in Low-Resource Healthcare Settings
summary: Aletheia is an offline-first clinical decision support system developed to assist with differential diagnosis in low-resource healthcare settings, addressing limited access to specialist expertise.

title: AdaKP: Online Adaptive Knowledge-Point Selection for Reasoning-Oriented Reinforcement Learning
summary: AdaKP proposes an online adaptive knowledge-point selection method for reasoning-oriented reinforcement learning, aiming to mitigate reward sparsity in large language models.

title: MusiChat: Vibe Composing for Music Creation
summary: MusiChat is an AI system for music creation that enables "vibe composing" and iterative refinement, moving beyond traditional prompt-and-regenerate paradigms in music generation.

title: Understanding Semantic IDs: From Item Representation to Item Selection in Generative Recommendation
summary: This research investigates Semantic IDs (SIDs) within generative recommendation systems, analyzing their role in item representation and selection.

title: Chart-Supported or Model-Supplied? Examining MLLM-Generated Claims for Accessible Visualization
summary: This study examines claims generated by Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for accessible visualization, questioning the evidential basis of their interpretations of charts.

title: SAFAARI: Schema-Aware Framework for Accelerated Advertiser Response Intelligence
summary: SAFAARI introduces a schema-aware framework designed to accelerate advertiser response intelligence by enabling agentic chatbots to access enterprise data without predefined API endpoints.

title: CogEEGAgent: Toward Autonomous Cognitive EEG Analysis with Grounded Execution and Selection-Aware Verification
summary: CogEEGAgent explores the development of LLM agents for autonomous cognitive EEG analysis, enabling grounded execution and selection-aware verification from natural-language questions.

title: Psychological Influences of Conversational AI: Research and Design Directions for Reducing Harm and Promoting Well-Being
summary: This research explores the psychological influences of conversational AI, proposing design directions to mitigate harm and promote user well-being as these systems become more integrated into daily life.

title: Similar Models Learn Differently: Final-Window Pretraining Shapes Post-Training Beyond SFT
summary: This paper investigates how different model checkpoints behave after supervised fine-tuning, influencing their readiness for subsequent alignment stages. It finds that even models performing similarly on benchmarks may have different underlying learning characteristics.

title: Addressable Recall Compaction for Long Context-Window Control in AI Agents
summary: This paper proposes a new method called Addressable Recall Compaction to manage long context windows in AI agents, addressing limitations of existing information discarding or summarizing techniques. It aims to prevent task-critical details from being lost due to context window overflow.

title: How Often Should a Recommender Call an LLM? Value-Weighted Routing, Monitoring, and Seasonal Robustness
summary: This research proposes a value-weighted routing strategy for recommender systems to determine when to use an expensive large language model versus a cheaper heuristic, considering both difficulty and business value. It addresses monitoring and seasonal robustness in such systems.

title: Towards an Agent Operating System - Lessons from Classical and Cloud OS
summary: This paper outlines the concept of an 'Agent Operating System,' drawing parallels from classical and cloud OS development to propose stable abstractions for building and consolidating AI agent frameworks. It aims to streamline the development and deployment of agentic systems.

title: PLATO: Pointer Learner for Agent and Task Openness
summary: PLATO (Pointer Learner for Agent and Task Openness) is a new approach designed for multi-agent reinforcement learning in open agent systems where agents and tasks can change unpredictably. It addresses the fundamental challenges of agent and task openness in MARL.

title: Matryoshka Agent: Unfolding Sub-Agents for Long-Horizon Machine Learning Engineering
summary: The Matryoshka Agent is a novel agentic system that unfolds sub-agents to tackle long-horizon machine learning engineering tasks involving iterative debugging and refinement. It aims to overcome the challenges of developing monolithic agents for such complex processes.

title: Towards Robust Reinforcement Learning for Small-Scale Language Model Agents
summary: This research systematically investigates the instability and failure mechanisms of reinforcement learning when used to align small-scale language model agents (70-500M parameters). The goal is to develop more robust reinforcement learning techniques for these SLM agents.

title: ScalableRAG: High-Quality RAG at Zero Ingestion Cost
summary: ScalableRAG is a new method designed to achieve high-quality Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with zero ingestion costs, unlike existing approaches that require expensive knowledge graph or SQL table creation. It aims to replicate the benefits of such knowledge bases without the overhead.

title: Less Data, Better Alignment: Data-Centric Multi-Evaluator Agreement for Preference Optimization
summary: This research introduces DMAPO (Data-centric Multi-evaluator Agreement for Preference Optimization), a method that investigates whether a small, high-confidence dataset of on-policy responses can reliably guide preference optimization for model alignment. It focuses on the impact of data quality rather than quantity in alignment.

title: How Affect Propagates among LLM Agents: Emergent Emotional Contagion in Crowd Simulation
summary: This paper examines the propagation of affect and emergent emotional contagion among language model agents within a multi-agent crowd simulation. It focuses on how agents perceive, appraise, and respond to their neighbors through various channels.

title: When Do Agent Loops Mistake Stagnation for Progress? Self-Evaluation Bias and Externally Grounded Verification in Long-Running Autonomous LLM Agent Loops
summary: This research identifies and analyzes "progress mistaken for stagnation" as a failure mode in long-running autonomous LLM agent loops, caused by self-evaluation bias. It proposes using externally grounded verification to mitigate this issue.

title: PreDiff-LM: Pretrained Discrete Masked Diffusion Language Modeling with Hybrid Attention
summary: PreDiff-LM is a new pretrained discrete masked diffusion language model featuring hybrid attention, designed to support bidirectional generation and infilling tasks. It addresses the challenges of reconciling causal pretraining with bidirectional denoising in such models.

title: Observing sycophantic AI validate others reduces its appeal but not its persuasiveness
summary: This study examines "sycophantic AI," showing that while users' awareness of an AI's overly agreeable nature reduces its appeal, it does not diminish the AI's persuasiveness. It highlights a phenomenon called "sycophancy blindness."

title: Everyone is unique: Towards Behaviorally Heterogeneous Negotiation Dialogue Systems for Debt Collection
summary: This research aims to develop behaviorally heterogeneous negotiation dialogue systems for debt collection, leveraging large language models to address the complexities of this high-stakes financial domain. It emphasizes tailoring interactions to individual behaviors.

title: CADENCE: A Cardiac Atom Dictionary for Interpretable Neural Concept Extraction from ECG Foundation Models
summary: CADENCE is a framework designed for interpreting 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) foundation models by decomposing them into a human-understandable dictionary of cardiac physiological concepts. It aims to make AI models in healthcare more transparent.

title: The User Asks, Platforms Compete: How Agentic Recommendation Markets Take Shape
summary: This paper explores how LLM-based user agents are transforming online recommendation, enabling a new market dynamic where users specify needs before choosing a platform, leading to increased competition among platforms. It details the emergence of agentic recommendation markets.

title: Many-body Tipping Dynamics of ChatGPT-like AIs
summary: This research investigates the "many-body tipping dynamics" in ChatGPT-like AIs, explaining how they can unexpectedly generate undesirable content. It attributes these sudden shifts to complex interactions between tokens within the model.

title: ContractHIL-HLS: Contract-Aligned Multi-Agent Workflow with Hardware-in-the-Loop Feedback for HLS Design
summary: ContractHIL-HLS presents a contract-aligned multi-agent workflow for practical high-level synthesis (HLS) design engineering, incorporating hardware-in-the-loop feedback. It utilizes a structured contract for semantic alignment and task execution within the agent system.

title: Instruction-Tuned Language Models Cannot Sample from Distributions They Can Describe
summary: This paper argues that instruction-tuned language models do not sample from distributions they can describe, instead collapsing to a single output. This challenges the methodology of using models as proxies for human survey respondents.

title: Physics-Grounded Fluid Video Generation with a Simulation Dataset and Dual-Stream Optical-Flow Supervision
summary: This paper introduces a method for physics-grounded fluid video generation that addresses physical inaccuracies in existing diffusion models. It achieves this by using a simulation dataset and dual-stream optical-flow supervision.

title: From Cellular Responses to Pharmacological Domains: Multimodal Zero-Shot Drug Representation Learning
summary: This research proposes a multimodal zero-shot drug representation learning method that incorporates cellular responses like gene expression and cell morphology to improve drug discovery. It aims to overcome limitations of direct fusion by modeling mechanism-related signals.

title: Dual-Domain Manifold Modeling for Hyperspectral Image Fusion
summary: This paper introduces a dual-domain manifold modeling approach to address challenges in hyperspectral image fusion, aiming to better integrate spectral richness and spatial fidelity. It focuses on effectively modeling geometric constraints for improved results.

title: Cardiologent: Multi-Agent Clinical Decision Support for Patient-Level Arrhythmia Assessment, Urgency, and Management
summary: Cardiologent is a multi-agent clinical decision support system designed for patient-level arrhythmia assessment, urgency determination, and management. It focuses on improving clinical judgment beyond just naming the rhythm.

title: Explanation-Bound Tool Execution for AI Agents: Server-Verified Action Claims Without Trusting Model Rationales
summary: This paper introduces Explanation-Bound Tool Execution (EBTE), a mediation layer that enables server-verified action claims for AI agents using tools. It aims to improve reliability by converting decision-relevant rationale content into typed claims without trusting model rationales.

title: AI Deployment and Cyber Governance Failures in Public-Sector Organizations: A Typological Analysis
summary: This typological analysis examines failures in AI deployment and cyber governance within public-sector organizations, considering institutional constraints. It explores the unexamined intersection of these topics in existing literature.

title: Ranní výběr: Kostní dřeň a AI? Tyhle startupy klepou na vrata jednorožčí stáje
summary: This morning news selection highlights Czech startups, including those in the AI sector, that are showing high growth potential to become unicorns.

title: TimeCapsule: Generative Hallucination as a Method for Historical Sensemaking
summary: TimeCapsule is a 1.2B-parameter LLaMA-style causal model, trained exclusively on Victorian texts (1800-1875) to provide historical context and avoid the temporal overexposure of contemporary large language models.

title: Measuring and Improving Behavioral Consistency in Large Language Models through Fact-Heuristic-Emotion State Enforcement
summary: This research investigates the behavioral inconsistency of Large Language Models (LLMs) across decision-making runs and proposes a method, using Fact-Heuristic-Emotion State Enforcement, to measure and reduce this instability without altering model weights.

title: Neuromorphic Diffusion Language Models: Addressing Compute and Memory Bottlenecks via Sparsity and Block Denoising
summary: This paper proposes neuromorphic diffusion language models to address the compute and memory bottlenecks of autoregressive large language models through sparsity and block denoising, aiming for greater inference efficiency.

title: CogArena: A Multimethod Evaluation of Cognitive Ability Structure in Large Language Models
summary: CogArena is a new procedurally generated, 13-paradigm benchmark designed for multimethod evaluation of cognitive ability structures in large language models, allowing for systematic comparison and profiling.

title: DS@GT ARC at CheckThat! 2026: LLM-Based Trace Ranking and Grouped Reward Modeling for Multilingual Numerical Claim Verification
summary: This paper describes a system for CLEF 2026 CheckThat! Task 2, which uses LLM-based trace ranking and grouped reward modeling to achieve multilingual numerical claim verification.

title: Evaluating Communicative Belief Updates in Large Language Models via Implicature Recognition and Cancellation
summary: This paper evaluates the ability of large language models to recognize unspoken beliefs through implicatures and understand communicative belief updates, which are critical for effective human-AI communication.

title: TabRank: Chain-of-Thought Distillation for Table Re-Rankers
summary: This paper introduces TabRank, a method utilizing Chain-of-Thought Distillation to enhance table re-rankers, which are essential components for refining candidate lists in multi-stage structured information retrieval systems.

title: A scaling law of contextual persistence in human language
summary: This research identifies a scaling law of contextual persistence in human language, demonstrating that the arrangement of words follows a predictable structure, with large language models used as probabilistic sensors for this discovery.

title: MyoCardBench: A Real-World Data Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Clinically Authentic Cardiovascular Care Scenarios
summary: This paper introduces MyoCardBench, a new real-world benchmark designed to evaluate large language models (LLMs) specifically in clinically authentic cardiovascular care scenarios.

title: A Cross-lingual Comparison of Human and Classification Model Entrainment Behavior in Code-switched Speech Settings
summary: This research presents a cross-lingual analysis of conversational entrainment in Mandarin-English, Hindi-English, and Spanish-English code-switched speech, comparing human and classification model behaviors.

title: Interpretable Column Annotation with LLM-Symbolized Decision Process Materialization
summary: This paper proposes a method for interpretable column annotation (CA) that leverages LLM-symbolized decision processes to identify meanings and semantic relationships within table columns using neural models.

title: Where Steering Signals Come From: Activation Source Selection in Activation Steering
summary: This study investigates activation source selection in language model steering, analyzing how the choice of source context and specific signals influences the control of LLMs by adding vectors to hidden states during inference.

title: CoSA: Accelerating Long-Context Inference via Proxy-Kernel Co-Designed Sparse Attention
summary: This paper introduces CoSA, a method that accelerates long-context inference in large language models by using proxy-kernel co-designed sparse attention to address the quadratic cost of self-attention.

title: CAST: Game Solvers as Turn-Level Teachers for LLM Agents
summary: This paper proposes CAST, a method for training large language model (LLM) agents in long-horizon games by using game solvers as 'turn-level teachers' to provide denser process signals for reinforcement learning.

title: Every Time I Hire a Linguist, Inference Costs Go Down: On Linguistic Rules as Effective Prompt Compressors
summary: This research explores the use of linguistic rules as effective prompt compressors to shorten large language model (LLM) input, aiming to reduce inference costs more efficiently than existing token importance scoring methods.

title: Inspect India Evals: An Open Benchmarking Framework for Evaluating Large Language Models in the Indian Linguistic and Cultural Context
summary: Inspect India Evals introduces an open benchmarking framework specifically designed for evaluating large language models (LLMs) within the diverse linguistic and cultural contexts of India.

title: Memory for Large Language Models
summary: This article discusses how memory has become a foundational architectural dimension in large language models (LLMs), evolving into explicit and controllable mechanisms beyond implicit computational byproducts.

title: Phase Structure in Rotary Attention: A Spectral Framework for Semantic Continuity and Execution-Boundary Governance
summary: This paper develops a bounded spectral framework to examine the phase structure in rotary attention for Transformer language models, focusing on rotary phase alignment and hidden-state continuity.

title: IRIS: Reusable Identity Representations from Frozen LLMs for Entity Alignment
summary: This paper introduces IRIS, a method that leverages reusable identity representations from frozen large language models (LLMs) for improved entity alignment across knowledge graphs.

title: Evaluation of forced alignment of code-mixed speech: the case of Hindi-English
summary: This research evaluates the forced alignment of Hindi-English code-mixed speech using the Montreal Forced Aligner, addressing challenges posed by expanded inventories, orthographic errors, and speaker variation.

title: PILA: Plug-and-Play Insertion for LLM-native Advertising
summary: This paper proposes PILA, a 'plug-and-play' insertion method for LLM-native advertising, which aims to naturally integrate sponsored content into large language model responses without entangling it with content generation.

title: A Human-in-the-Loop Corpus for LLM-Based Simplification of Scientific Summaries
summary: This research introduces a human-in-the-loop corpus and workflow for large language model (LLM)-based simplification of scientific summaries, making complex papers more accessible for interdisciplinary understanding.

title: Construction-Driven Injection: Linguistically-Grounded Edit-Based Code-Mixing Fingerprints for Large Language Models
summary: This paper proposes 'Construction-Driven Injection,' a method for embedding linguistically-grounded, edit-based code-mixing fingerprints into large language models (LLMs) to provide a black-box verifiable ownership signal and deter unauthorized redistribution.

title: MyMentorLLM: A psychotherapy GenAI environment with multimodal voice/text patients, trainees and experts for deliberate practice
summary: MyMentorLLM is introduced as a multimodal voice and text-based generative AI simulation environment designed for deliberate practice in psychotherapy, featuring virtual patients, trainees, and experts.

title: SpeechLLM Meets Federated Learning for End-to-End ASR: English and Italian Case Studies
summary: This paper presents the first systematic study of federated learning (FL) for training SpeechLLMs in end-to-end automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems, with case studies in English and Italian, focusing on privacy-preserving training.

title: Evaluation of Adversarial Robustness in Arabic Language Models
summary: This research evaluates the adversarial robustness of Arabic Language Models, exploring their vulnerabilities to attacks that can deceive the models into making incorrect predictions.

title: AngelSpec: Towards Real-World High Performance Inference with Speculative Decoding
summary: This paper introduces AngelSpec, a method aimed at achieving real-world high-performance inference for large language models through improved speculative decoding, addressing limitations of existing drafting structures.

title: Shieldstral
summary: This paper introduces Shieldstral, a new 3-billion-parameter policy-adaptive multimodal safety classifier that achieves state-of-the-art performance on text and multimodal safety classification benchmarks.

title: AI's Capability in Assisting Scientific Research in Physics, Astrophysics, and Cosmology II: Project Planning and Proposal Evaluation
summary: This item investigates how large language models (LLMs) can assist with scientific project planning and proposal evaluation in physics, astrophysics, and cosmology by generating project plans.

title: Evaluating Multi-Turn Multimodal Diagnostic Reasoning on Challenging Real-World Clinical Cases
summary: This item focuses on evaluating multi-turn multimodal diagnostic reasoning in AI models for challenging real-world clinical cases, assessing their ability to refine diagnoses with progressive information.

title: Polistemics: Evaluating LLMs as Information Mediators in Politics & Elections
summary: This item introduces Polistemics, a new theory-grounded benchmark designed to evaluate large language models (LLMs) as responsible mediators of political information during elections.

title: Detecting Knowledge Inconsistencies Across Text, Tables, and Knowledge Graphs
summary: This item explores methods for detecting knowledge inconsistencies across different modalities like text, tables, and knowledge graphs, which are crucial for LLM pre-training and retrieval-augmented generation.

title: Instruction-Tuned Models Locally Reuse Human Syntax More Than Humans Do
summary: This item presents a finding that instruction-tuned large language models (LLMs) tend to reuse human syntax more locally than humans do, exploring syntactic convergence in AI.

title: UniMem: Complementary Episodic-to-Parametric Memory for Boundary-Agnostic Task Streams
summary: This item introduces UniMem, a complementary episodic-to-parametric memory system designed for LLM agents to accumulate task experience and reuse execution strategies across evolving task streams.

title: Pass the Baton: Trajectory-Relayed On-Policy Distillation
summary: This item proposes a new method called 'Trajectory-Relayed On-Policy Distillation' to address prefix failure in token-level supervision, improving model generation quality.

title: DocAnnot -- Accelerating the Creation of Key Information Extraction Datasets with GenAI-Powered Auto-annotation
summary: This item introduces DocAnnot, a framework that leverages Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) to significantly accelerate the creation of key information extraction (KIE) datasets through auto-annotation.

title: VLD-RAG: Agentic Vision-Language Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Long, Visually-Rich Multi-Page Documents
summary: This item presents VLD-RAG, an agentic vision-language retrieval-augmented generation system designed for question answering over long, visually-rich multi-page documents by integrating multimodal retrieval.

title: Language as a Material Interface for Creative LLM Interaction
summary: This item explores language as a material interface for creative interaction with Large Language Models (LLMs), moving beyond directive prompting to open-ended and associative linguistic exchanges.

title: The Effect of Text Chunk Size on Retrieval-Augmented Generation Performance
summary: This item investigates the critical impact of text chunk size on the performance of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, analyzing the granularity of source documents for LLMs.

title: From Naive RAG to Deep Agentic Retrieval: An Evolving Context Engineering Pipeline for Regulatory Compliance
summary: This item traces the development of a production retrieval pipeline for regulatory compliance, evolving from naive Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to deep agentic retrieval for enterprise document corpora.

title: Retrieval, not hallucinations, will be the limiting factor for LLM-based clinical AI tools
summary: This item argues that retrieval quality, rather than hallucinations, will be the primary limiting factor for LLM-based clinical AI tools, shifting the focus to recall errors in medical contexts.

title: Reading Without a Reader: Large Language Models Collapse Reading and Writing into a Single Entangled Code
summary: This item explores how decoder-only Large Language Models (LLMs) combine reading and writing into a single entangled code, contrasting this with the dissociated reading and writing systems in the human brain.

title: Influence of Prompt Engineering on Small Language Models for Guarded Query Routing
summary: This item studies the influence of prompt engineering on Small Language Models (SLMs) for 'guarded query routing,' where SLMs act as routers to direct or reject user queries based on distribution and safety.

title: SciClaimSeekers at CheckThat! 2026: Retrieving Scientific Sources for Social Media Claims with LLM Reranking
summary: This item presents SciClaimSeekers, a retrieval and reranking framework that combines BM25 and LLM reranking to effectively retrieve scientific sources for social media claims.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation in LLMs for Mental Health: Quantifying the Incremental Contribution of Retrieval Within a Layered Safety Architecture
summary: This item quantifies the incremental contribution of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) within a layered safety architecture for LLM-based mental health interventions, focusing on improved accuracy and safety.

title: Two Views, One Voice: Evidence-Grounded Conversational Music Recommendation
summary: This item addresses evidence-grounded conversational music recommendation by proposing methods to disentangle retrieval and response generation, ensuring credibility as dialogue evolves.

title: DisasterTD: Disaster Toponym Disambiguation Using Multimodal LLMs and Cross-View Geolocalization
summary: This item introduces DisasterTD, a system that uses multimodal LLMs and cross-view geolocalization to disambiguate disaster toponyms from social media imagery for improved situational awareness.

title: Harm is not Universal: Community-Specific Toxicity Detection is Urgently Needed
summary: Research shows state-of-the-art toxicity detectors in text-to-image generation fail to protect marginalized communities due to a one-size-fits-all approach, highlighting ethical concerns about bias and harm.

title: Mage-VL: An Efficient Codec-Native Streaming Multimodal Foundation Model
summary: Mage-VL is introduced as an efficient codec-native streaming multimodal foundation model designed for real-time multimodal understanding, addressing limitations of standard vision-language models in streaming perception tasks.

title: PerceptionBench: Evaluating Atomic Visual Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: PerceptionBench is introduced as a new benchmark to specifically evaluate the atomic visual perception capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), aiming to isolate perceptual errors from reasoning failures.

title: Enabling Fully Integer-Only Inference for Lightweight Detection Transformers
summary: A method is proposed to enable fully integer-only inference for lightweight detection transformers, making them deployable on NPUs and microcontrollers by addressing compatibility issues with integer arithmetic.

title: Diff-ID: Identity Consistent Facial Image Generation and Morphing via Diffusion Models
summary: Diff-ID is presented as a method for identity-consistent facial image generation and morphing using diffusion models, crucial for applications like security systems and biometric authentication.

title: MorphUNet: Alpha-Controlled Biometric Transport for Diffusion-Based Face Morphing Attacks
summary: MorphUNet is introduced as a diffusion morphing framework that uses alpha-controlled biometric transport to generate face morphing attacks verifiable against multiple identities, posing a threat to identity verification systems.

title: IMPRINT: Image-Conditioned Query Enrichment for Long-Tail Object Goal Navigation
summary: IMPRINT proposes an image-conditioned query enrichment method for long-tail Object Goal Navigation in Embodied AI, improving reliability for semantic specificity compared to text-only queries.

title: OPERA: Offline Policy-guided Expert Routing and Adaptation for Universal Biomedical Image Analysis
summary: OPERA is presented as a method for offline policy-guided expert routing and adaptation to achieve universal biomedical image analysis, overcoming distribution shifts and reducing the need for repeated domain-specific fine-tuning.

title: LENS: Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Zooming for Keyframe Sampling in Long-Form Videos
summary: LENS proposes an adaptive spatio-temporal zooming method for keyframe sampling in long-form videos, addressing the challenge of limited context windows in Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs).

title: OrganLens: Organ-Specific Representation Learning for CT Foundation Models
summary: OrganLens introduces an organ-specific representation learning approach for CT foundation models, enabling better analysis of individual organs within a CT volume for biomedical questions.

title: LGFNet: A CTC-Guided Local-Global Fusion Framework for Single-Channel Sleep Staging
summary: LGFNet is proposed as a CTC-Guided Local-Global Fusion Framework for challenging single-channel sleep staging, designed to handle long-range temporal dependencies and distribution shifts across subjects.

title: ObliCity: A Benchmark and Baseline for Roof-to-Ground Projection Displacement Correction
summary: ObliCity introduces a new benchmark and baseline for roof-to-ground projection displacement correction in oblique-view urban remote sensing imagery, which often suffers from significant geometric distortions.

title: WHTMix: Efficient Stereo Depth Estimation via Walsh-Hadamard Token Mixing
summary: WHTMix proposes an efficient stereo depth estimation method using Walsh-Hadamard Token Mixing to address the quadratic runtime of global self-attention in transformer-based matchers, critical for high-resolution applications under tight latency budgets.

title: Medical world models in healthcare: foundations, applications, and challenges for trustworthy clinical translation
summary: This review paper defines and explores medical world models in healthcare, outlining their foundations, applications, and challenges for trustworthy clinical translation by representing evolving patient states.

title: FORGE: Frame Orthogonality in Relevance Geometry for Long-Form Video Understanding
summary: FORGE introduces a method called Frame Orthogonality in Relevance Geometry for long-form video understanding, aiming to improve Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) by focusing on relevant content and reducing the impact of irrelevant frames.

title: ScaleResfusion: Residual Rectified Flow based on Residual Vector Field
summary: ScaleResfusion is a new method for real-world image restoration based on Residual Rectified Flow and Residual Vector Field, addressing challenges in recovering high-quality images from complex degradations.

title: FunnelAL: Retrieve-then-Rank Active Learning for Single-Class Discovery
summary: FunnelAL is presented as a retrieve-then-rank active learning system for single-class discovery, adapting industrial recommender system architectures to efficiently find relevant samples for data annotation in large-scale supervised learning.

title: CLBench-V: Evaluating Multimodal Context Learning from Grounding to Knowledge Acquisition
summary: CLBench-V introduces a new benchmark for evaluating multimodal context learning, designed to assess how models learn from task-specific contexts that include both visual and textual information.

title: MEDit-Bench: A Dataset for Evaluating Message-Driven Narrative Video Editing
summary: MEDit-Bench is introduced as a new dataset for evaluating message-driven narrative video editing, addressing the need for benchmarks that reflect editorial intent beyond simple video summarization.

title: Human-in-the-Loop Signature Bootstrapping for UAV Hyperspectral PFM-1 Mine Detection
summary: This paper proposes a human-in-the-loop method for detecting PFM-1 landmines using hyperspectral imaging from unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). It focuses on improving material discrimination for mine screening to reduce false alarms.

title: Sense it with your eyes: Sensation Generation and Understanding for Advertisements
summary: This research explores using AI to generate and understand sensory advertisements that visually evoke human senses to create a more persuasive impact. It investigates how AI can improve creative content generation and understanding in advertising.

title: Beyond Background Bias: Saliency-Driven Prototype Alignment for Dataset Distillation
summary: This paper proposes a saliency-driven prototype alignment method for dataset distillation to improve structural coherence and generalization in synthesized datasets. It aims to create compact datasets that approximate full-data training performance.

title: Balanced Soft mixture-of-expert model for Glaucoma Detection
summary: This paper introduces a balanced soft mixture-of-expert model designed for early detection of glaucoma, a leading cause of irreversible vision loss. The model aims to improve the identification of this disease, which often develops slowly and painlessly.

title: Gaussian Volumetric Representation for Efficient Shear-Warp Visualization
summary: This paper proposes a Gaussian-based volumetric representation to enable efficient shear-warp visualization for medical images. The method aims to preserve anatomical fidelity while achieving high rendering speeds for large volumetric datasets.

title: HOME: Robust Hough-space Matching Method for Structured and Textureless Videos
summary: This paper introduces "HOME," a robust Hough-space matching method designed for visual front-ends in robotic localization, particularly in structured or textureless environments. It aims to overcome limitations of point-based features in such challenging settings.

title: Noise-Free One-Step LoRA for Task-Driven Image Restoration with Diffusion Priors
summary: This paper proposes a noise-free one-step LoRA method for task-driven image restoration using diffusion priors. It aims to jointly optimize restoration quality and performance for high-level vision tasks.

title: RDVSv2: A Large-scale Benchmark for RGB-D Video Salient Object Detection
summary: This paper introduces RDVSv2, a large-scale benchmark dataset for RGB-D video salient object detection with dense frame-level annotations. It aims to address limitations in scale and annotation quality of existing datasets in the field.

title: Towards Reliable Stain Transfer: An Iterative Data-Model Co-Optimization Framework Based on Multimodal Expert-Guided Assessment
summary: This paper proposes an iterative data-model co-optimization framework for reliable stain transfer in histopathological examination. It uses multimodal expert-guided assessment to computationally generate stains as an alternative to costly IHC.

title: Reading Legends on Ancient Coins: An Object Detection Approach for Character Recognition on a Novel Roman Republican Dataset
summary: This paper presents an object detection approach for character recognition to read legends on ancient Roman Republican coins. It addresses the challenge of classifying ancient coins by their textual inscriptions using a novel dataset.

title: DensFiLM: Density-Conditioned Video Saliency for Crowd Scenes
summary: This paper introduces DensFiLM, a density-conditioned video saliency model that adapts its fixation strategy based on crowd density. It aims to improve attention prediction in crowd scenes by recognizing shifts from individual tracking to collective motion.

title: Seen, Said, or Forgotten? A Causal Audit of Visual KV Memory Across Dialog Turns
summary: This paper conducts a causal audit of visual Key-Value memory in stateful multimodal assistants to determine when visual information can be safely forgotten across dialogue turns. It questions assumptions about the dispensability of irrelevant evidence.

title: Safety-Aware Cascaded Inference for Crop Damage Assessment with Controlled Error Trade-offs
summary: This paper proposes a safety-aware cascaded inference method for crop damage assessment in agricultural insurance, focusing on controlling error trade-offs. It addresses the issue where missed damage detections are more costly than false alarms for smallholder farmers.

title: Agentic AI in medicine: architectures, applications, evaluation, and challenges for clinical translation
summary: This article surveys agentic AI in medicine, covering its architectures, applications, evaluation, and challenges for clinical translation. It explores how large language and multimodal models enable multistep clinical tasks requiring planning and tool use.

title: Beyond Counts: A Distributional Robustness Margin For Pathology Foundation Models
summary: This paper proposes a Distributional Robustness Margin for pathology foundation models to address their vulnerability to non-biological variations across different medical centers. It aims to improve model generalization by mitigating shortcut learning caused by such variations.

title: Group Equivariant Diffusion for Anomaly Detection in Computational Cytology
summary: This paper introduces a Group Equivariant Diffusion method for anomaly detection in computational cytology, specifically for identifying malignant cells in whole-slide images. The method aims to overcome challenges posed by rare, heterogeneous malignant cells and scarce annotated slides.

title: I2VShield: An Efficient Proactive Defense Framework against DiT-based Image-to-Video Models
summary: This paper introduces I2VShield, an efficient proactive defense framework designed to counter the misuse of DiT-based image-to-video generation models. It addresses the increasing challenge of detecting AI-generated videos and preventing their malicious use.

title: Argus-Unified: Towards A Compact and Economical Unified Model for Image Understanding and Generation
summary: This paper presents Argus-Unified, a compact and economical unified model designed for both image understanding and generation capabilities. It aims to address the challenges of high computational and data demands in unifying these visual tasks.

title: Visual prompt engineering for video models
summary: This paper explores visual prompt engineering as an essential technique for improving the performance of video models, similar to its role in language models. It examines how prompting can enhance visual reasoning and other video-related tasks.

title: Less is More: Modality-Decoupling for General AIGC Audio-Video Detection
summary: This paper proposes a modality-decoupling method for general AI-generated content (AIGC) audio-video detection, aiming to identify forgeries. It challenges the assumption of cross-modal inconsistencies by empirically finding they don't always hold.

title: Few-Shot Open-Vocabulary Remote Sensing Segmentation via Textual Inversion
summary: This item introduces a method for few-shot open-vocabulary segmentation in remote sensing imagery using textual inversion, addressing performance gaps related to text queries.

title: ReDesign: Recovering Editable Design Structures from Images via Agentic Decomposition
summary: This item presents ReDesign, a system that recovers editable design structures from raster images by employing agentic decomposition to handle multi-modal attributes like typography and geometry.

title: The LAIA Dataset: Labelled Attention for Intelligent Automobiles
summary: This item introduces The LAIA Dataset, providing labelled attention data for developing data-driven AI models in autonomous vehicles, supporting both modular and end-to-end driving paradigms.

title: Forensic Reproducibility Audit of a Radiology Vision-Language Model Benchmark: From Intended Protocol to Released Artifact
summary: This item details a forensic reproducibility audit of a radiology vision-language model benchmark, evaluating the consistency between its intended protocol and released artifacts including datasets and code.

title: Beyond Facial Consistency: Personalized Person Image Generation with Holistic Identity Preservation
summary: This item describes a new method for personalized person image generation that achieves holistic identity preservation, balancing fidelity of facial details with overall appearance consistency.

title: OmniPhys: Knowledge-Graph-Driven Benchmarking and Collective Optimization for Physical Commonsense in Text-to-Image Generation
summary: This item introduces OmniPhys, a knowledge-graph-driven simulation platform designed for benchmarking and optimizing text-to-image models to improve their physical commonsense understanding and reduce violations.

title: Instruction-based Image Editing: A Survey on Data, Models, Evaluation, and Applications
summary: This item is a survey on instruction-based image editing (IIE), covering data, models, evaluation, and applications, and highlighting advancements driven by Large Language Models and Vision-Language Models.

title: Impact Detection in Fall Events: Leveraging Spatio-Temporal Graph Convolutional Networks and Recurrent Neural Networks Using 3D Skeletons Data
summary: This item presents a method for impact detection in fall events using Spatio-Temporal Graph Convolutional Networks and Recurrent Neural Networks, leveraging 3D skeleton data for a critical health concern.

title: Egocentric Station Holding of Robotic Fish in Unknown Turbulent Background Flow
summary: This item addresses the challenge of robotic fish holding station in unknown turbulent water, a fundamental capability for operating in natural aquatic environments that remains underdeveloped.

title: Steeringless Drifting: Differential-Torque Control of a Four-Wheel Independently Driven Vehicle
summary: This item investigates differential-torque control for a four-wheel independently driven vehicle to achieve steeringless drifting, enhancing control methods for autonomous driving at handling limits.

title: Amortising Trajectory Optimisation for Residual MPC via Implicit Contact Differentiation
summary: This item explores amortising trajectory optimisation for residual Model Predictive Control (MPC) through implicit contact differentiation, aiming to accelerate contact-rich trajectory optimisation using differentiable simulation.

title: Hybrid Artificial Potential Fields and Spatio-Temporal Transformers for Real-Time AUV Path Planning
summary: This item presents a comparative evaluation of thirteen path planning algorithms for Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs), utilizing hybrid artificial potential fields and spatio-temporal transformers for real-time guidance.

title: Leveraging Semantic Maps for City-Scale Cross-View Localization
summary: This item proposes leveraging semantic maps, such as OpenStreetMap data, for city-scale cross-view localization, enabling robots to localize in untraversed environments against available prior information.

title: SONG: A Photorealistic 3D Gaussian Simulation Platform for Benchmarking Social Navigation
summary: This item introduces SONG, a photorealistic 3D Gaussian simulation platform for benchmarking social navigation, enabling robots to develop socially compliant behavior from onboard visual observations.

title: Decompose and Reorganize: Planning with Primitives and Visuomotor Policies Learned from Demonstrations
summary: This item proposes a framework for dexterous, long-horizon robotic manipulation that combines high-level planning with primitives and visuomotor policies learned from demonstrations.

title: Room-Mediated Co-occurrence for Zero-Shot Object-Centric Semantic Navigation via Frontier Scoring
summary: This item describes a training-free semantic navigation pipeline for robots that uses room-mediated co-occurrence for zero-shot object-centric navigation via frontier scoring, overcoming limitations of direct object similarity.

title: A Causality-aware Infer-diagnose-refine Framework for Test-time Modality Adaptation in VLA Models
summary: This item introduces a causality-aware infer-diagnose-refine framework for test-time modality adaptation in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, specifically for robot manipulation tasks.

title: P3: Probabilistic Policy Propagation for Stable VAE-Based Robot Learning
summary: This item presents P3 (Probabilistic Policy Propagation), a method designed to stabilize VAE-based robot learning by addressing the mismatch between stochastic latent variables and Proximal Policy Optimization.

title: When Does Legacy Data Start to Help? Emergent Transfer in Cross-Configuration Robot Learning
summary: This item investigates emergent transfer in cross-configuration robot learning, studying when legacy demonstration data benefits an upgraded robot platform with different sensor and actuator configurations.

title: Shared Voxel-Map-Based Cooperative Indoor UAV Guidance with a Multi-Agent Soft Actor-Critic Controller
summary: This item proposes a cooperative indoor UAV guidance framework that integrates a shared voxel-map world model with a multi-agent Soft Actor-Critic controller, enabling multiple drones to fuse LiDAR observations for navigation.

title: Cooperative Multi-UAV Navigation in Complex Environments via Systematic Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: This paper proposes a multi-agent deep reinforcement learning framework to address challenges in cooperative navigation of multiple UAVs in complex environments.

title: Tripody: An Overconstrained 3-SPR-like Parallel Robot for High-Reach Construction Tasks
summary: This paper introduces Tripody, an overconstrained 3-SPR-like parallel robot designed for high-reach construction tasks, offering a lightweight and accurate alternative to traditional manipulators.

title: Transformer Transformer: A Unified Model for Motion-Conditioned Robot Co-design
summary: This paper introduces a unified model for motion-conditioned robot co-design, aiming to generate complete robot designs that can track target end-effector trajectories from human demonstrations.

title: Modular Robotic Catheters for Endovascular Aneurysm Repair
summary: This research explores the development of modular robotic catheters designed to assist surgeons in navigating complex anatomical structures for endovascular aneurysm repair.

title: HiFi-UMI: Learning Deployable Manipulation Policies from High-Fidelity UMI Data Alone
summary: This paper proposes HiFi-UMI, a method for learning deployable robot manipulation policies solely from high-fidelity UMI (User-Managed Interaction) data, addressing data scarcity challenges.

title: SAM3D-Guided Object-Centric Representation Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: This research focuses on SAM3D-guided object-centric representation alignment to enhance 3D understanding in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for general robot manipulation tasks.

title: Physics-Aware End-to-End Deep Reinforcement Learning for Quadcopter Control with Actuator Dynamics
summary: This paper investigates a physics-aware, end-to-end deep reinforcement learning approach for autonomous control of quadcopters, addressing challenges posed by their underactuated dynamics.

title: S2A2: Audio-Visual Imitation Learning for Manipulation Tasks Using Acoustic Spatial Information
summary: This paper introduces S2A2, a method for audio-visual imitation learning where robots use acoustic spatial information to determine manipulation targets in various tasks.

title: $\pi\mathbf{R}^2$: Reactive Real-time Flow Policies
summary: This research proposes $\pi\mathbf{R}^2$, a system for reactive real-time flow policies aimed at improving the reactivity of generalist manipulation policies built on large pretrained backbones.

title: INTACT: Isomorphic Intent-to-Action Learning for Search-Free World Models
summary: INTACT introduces an end-to-end JEPA (Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture) for isomorphic intent-to-action learning, enabling search-free action recovery for desired changes in latent world models.

title: Calibrated Partial Resets: Preventing Policy Collapse in Continual Reinforcement Learning
summary: This paper proposes calibrated partial resets as a method to prevent policy collapse and maintain plasticity in neural networks during continual reinforcement learning.

title: Extended Reality as a Mediation Layer for Situated Human Control in Human-Robot Teaming
summary: This paper argues for understanding Extended Reality (XR) as a mediation layer that facilitates situated human control within human-robot teaming scenarios.

title: Critical slowing down for predicting controller induced loss of control in quadrotors
summary: This research develops a novel forecasting scheme using critical slowing down (CSD) to anticipate controller-induced loss of control in quadrotors, validated on real flight data.

title: Untangling Co-Drift: Proactive Multi-Intent Failure Prediction and Root-Cause Disambiguation for Self-Driving Networks
summary: This work addresses proactive multi-intent failure prediction and root-cause disambiguation in self-driving networks by analyzing operational macro-intents.

title: Pictura: Perspective-View Self-Play at Scale for Driving
summary: This paper introduces Pictura, a system that uses perspective-view self-play in simulation to produce robust driving policies at scale for autonomous driving applications.

title: A context-adaptive policy framework for robust and reactive robotic manipulation via uncertainty-aware imitation learning
summary: This research proposes a context-adaptive policy framework for robust and reactive robotic manipulation, achieved through uncertainty-aware imitation learning.

title: CycleVLA: Proactive Self-Correcting Vision-Language-Action Models via Subtask Backtracking and Minimum Bayes Risk Decoding
summary: This work introduces CycleVLA, a system that equips Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models with proactive self-correction capabilities for robot tasks, using subtask backtracking and Minimum Bayes Risk Decoding.

title: DSCD-Nav: Dual-Stance Cooperative Debate for Object Navigation
summary: This paper presents DSCD-Nav, a dual-stance cooperative debate approach for robust object navigation in unfamiliar indoor environments for household service robots.

title: RankFormer: A Propose-then-Select Transformer for Multi-Agent Multimodal Trajectory Prediction
summary: This paper proposes RankFormer, a propose-then-select transformer model designed for multi-agent multimodal trajectory prediction, relevant for applications like autonomous driving.

title: Nautilus: From One Prompt to Plug-and-Play Robot Learning
summary: Robot learning research, specifically the Nautilus framework, addresses challenges in porting learning across different robot systems.

title: Can Vision-Language-Action Models Learn from Real-World Data Continually without Forgetting?
summary: Investigates whether Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can continually acquire new skills from real-world data for general-purpose robotics without forgetting prior knowledge.

title: CADENCE: Predicting Realized MAPF Execution Time Beyond Sum of Costs
summary: Introduces CADENCE, a new method for predicting Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) execution time for robot teams, moving beyond standard evaluation metrics like Sum of Costs.

title: UniReLo: Learning a Unified Humanoid Policy from Fall Recovery to Locomotion across Diverse Terrains
summary: Presents UniReLo, a learned unified policy enabling humanoid robots to perform reliable fall recovery and locomotion across diverse terrains.

title: InDex: Empowering VLA Models with Intent-Conditioned Arm-Hand Coordination for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Proposes InDex, a method to empower Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models with intent-conditioned arm-hand coordination for precise dexterous manipulation in robotics.

title: RoboProcessBench: Benchmarking Process-Aware Understanding in Vision-Language Robotic Manipulation
summary: Introduces RoboProcessBench, a new benchmark for evaluating the process-aware understanding of Vision-Language Models in robotic manipulation tasks.

title: RoboMME-Interference: Benchmarking Robot Memory Under Interference
summary: Develops RoboMME-Interference, a benchmark designed to test and measure the long-term memory capabilities of robots under various interference conditions.

title: RoboHarness: Memory-Driven Orchestration of Heterogeneous Robot Policies for Long-Horizon Planning
summary: Introduces RoboHarness, a memory-driven orchestration system designed to coordinate heterogeneous robot policies for complex, long-horizon robotic planning tasks.

title: Towards Embodied Cognition in Robots via Spatially Grounded Synthetic Worlds
summary: Presents a conceptual framework and synthetic dataset for training Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in Visual Perspective Taking to achieve embodied cognition in robots.

title: Predictive Control for Driving under Uncertain Road Geometry Estimated from Onboard Vision
summary: Describes a predictive control system for autonomous vehicles that estimates uncertain road geometry from onboard vision to safely navigate unknown roads.
